errors.evidence: The list of methods omits "IKE," which is present in the legend and the plot. The description for the IKE line (red with triangle markers) is also missing.
The x-axis tick marks extend to 10^3 (1000), and the data points go even further, to approximately 3000. Stating the range ends at 1000 is incorrect.
The description omits the tick mark at 10³, which is clearly visible on the x-axis.
The visible range of the y-axis, as indicated by the tick labels, is from 30 to 55, not 0 to 55.
The 'Base' line starts at approximately 28.5%, which is noticeably below the 30% grid line.
The marker for the 'FT' method is a blue inverted triangle, not a regular triangle.
The 'FT' method starts at approximately 32% accuracy, not 34%.
The marker for the 'MEMIT' method is a purple pentagon, not a square. The green square marker corresponds to the 'ROME' method.
The 'ROME' method's final data point is at approximately 58%, which is clearly above the 55% grid line.
